items_flat.title_en: OpenAI introduces ChatGPT for Teens with Study Mode and stronger default protections
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 推出 ChatGPT for Teens：內建 Study Mode 與更強預設安全防護
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI announced ChatGPT for Teens, an experience that automatically activates for users estimated to be under 18 or who state ages 13-17. It centers on learning support via Study Mode (guiding questions and step-by-step help), responsible homework reminders that redirect shortcut attempts, quizzes, and Study Hours, plus default age-appropriate safeguards on self-harm, violence, eating disorders, and sexual/romantic roleplay, with optional parental controls for Quiet Hours and safety notifications.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 宣布推出 ChatGPT for Teens，系統估計未滿 18 歲或用戶自報 13-17 歲時自動啟用。核心為學習支援：Study Mode（引導提問與逐步協助）、負責作業提醒（將捷徑行為導向逐步解題）、測驗與 Study Hours，並預設加強自傷、暴力、飲食障礙及性/浪漫角色扮演等防護，家長可選用 Quiet Hours 與安全通知。
items_flat.analysis_en: This formalizes teen-specific product and model behavior after years of real-world youth usage and external scrutiny. The combination of learning-first defaults and stronger under-18 Model Spec rules aims to reduce both academic shortcut risks and exposure harms, though long-term efficacy of age prediction and parental opt-in remains to be measured in practice.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此舉將青少年專屬產品與模型行為正式化，回應多年實際使用與外部檢視。學習優先預設加上更強 under-18 Model Spec，試圖同時降低學業捷徑與暴露風險，但年齡預測與家長選用控制的長期效果仍待實際驗證。
items_flat.quote: We’re introducing ChatGPT for Teens, an experience designed to help teens learn, think critically, deepen understanding, and use AI with confidence. It provides stronger built-in safety protections for teens, including features to promote healthy use and additional controls for parents.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們推出 ChatGPT for Teens，這是一個幫助青少年學習、批判性思考、深化理解並有信心使用 AI 的體驗。它為青少年提供更強的內建安全防護，包括促進健康使用的功能以及家長的額外控制。

brief_en: OpenAI launched ChatGPT for Teens with built-in learning tools (Study Mode, homework redirects) and stronger default safety protections for users estimated or identified as 13-17. No other major frontier model releases or lab announcements verified in the latest 12-hour window.
brief_zh: OpenAI 推出 ChatGPT for Teens，內建學習工具（Study Mode、作業引導）與更強預設安全防護，適用於估計或自認 13-17 歲用戶。過去 12 小時未見其他主要 frontier 模型發布或大廠官方重大宣布。
